page.content:
Streaming service that carried the Bushiroad-era boom abroad.

How NJPW World connects

  • Topic: NJPW — NJPW World is New Japan's streaming home.
  • Faction: Bushiroad — Bushiroad launched NJPW World to stream New Japan globally.

What is NJPW World?

NJPW World is New Japan's streaming platform, the window that let English-speaking fans follow the G1, Wrestle Kingdom, and IWGP title matches live.

Key threads lead to NJPW and Bushiroad.
